messages:
Rae Coleman: Starting a tiny docs thread to align naming: I found ~18 places where the glossary term (snake_case) differs from SDK examples (camelCase). Want to standardize display rules.
Jon Park: Agreed. Proposal: docs show canonical (snake_case) in prose, code examples use SDK names with a short inline note: 'Docs canonical: <term>'.
Mei Lin: Also add glossary aliases so search works for both. And a short voice rule: use imperative verbs in headings, e.g., 'Set response length' not 'Response length settings'.
Rae Coleman: I'll open a PR with a mapping table and two example snippets. Jon can you confirm runtime will accept both names for the near term?
Jon Park: Yes, current shim accepts both; I'll file an RFC for deprecation timeline.
DocsBot: Reminder: run link-checker and add `docs/migration` label to the PR.
Rae Coleman: Assigned tasks: PR draft (Rae), aliases + search test (Mei), RFC (Jon). Will post PR link here when ready.
